questions.question: What two evils does God accuse his people of in Jeremiah 2?
options: Refusing entirely to pay the tithes that were owed to the priests
Breaking the holy Sabbath and wholly neglecting the temple worship
Forsaking him, the fountain of living waters, and digging broken cisterns
Marrying foreign wives and forsaking the wives of their own people
questions.answer: Forsaking him, the fountain of living waters, and digging broken cisterns

questions.question: What did the people exchange their glory for, according to Jeremiah 2?
options: The favor of the kings of Assyria
That which does not profit (worthless idols)
The wealth and chariots of Egypt
The empty wisdom of all the surrounding nations
questions.answer: That which does not profit (worthless idols)

questions.question: God recalls the devotion of Israel's youth, her love as a bride following him in the wilderness.
They have forsaken me, the fountain of living waters, and hewed out cisterns, broken cisterns that can hold no _____.
